newsitem.title: USA: Katy Industries stake cut by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Katy Industries stake cut by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Friday it reduced its stake in Katy Industries Inc to 1,753,800 common shares or 21.25 percent from 22.42 held in June.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 77,000 common shares sold between November 7 and January 7 at prices ranging from $11.2083 to $14.7540 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.
Katy, based in Elgin, Ill., is a diversified holding company with operations in industrial machinery, industrial components, consumer products and resource recovery.
